en: Black‑and‑white riverside view of a European city: a broad river with a paddle steamer and moored barges in the foreground, stone embankment at right, and an arched road or rail bridge crossing the water. On the hill beyond the bridge rises a large medieval complex consisting of a twin‑towered Gothic cathedral and adjoining castle‑like buildings, above a dense cluster of townhouses. Smokestacks in the distance emit smoke, suggesting industrial activity. The image is framed and retouched like an old photographic postcard.
